svg.title: Hawkeye 100 mm endmill cutout review preview
svg.desc: Exact XY cutter-sweep polygons parsed from 02-cutout-review.nc. Blue is the hanger-hole cut; red is the full-depth outside cut; amber is the outside contour at the tab floor. Stock is 110 by 110 mm, lower-left work origin.
svg.text: 100 mm nominal profile • assumed 3.175 mm endmill
Blue: hanger hole • red: through contour • amber: tab spans at Z −2.2
Offline review only; size, stock, feeds and breakthrough are unverified.
